sg_enact_top_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sg_top_1_index }
		set_variable = { name = sg_selected_index value = var:sg_top_1_index }
		sg_enact_selected = yes
		remove_variable = sg_selected_index
	}
}

sg_enact_top_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sg_top_2_index }

	}
}
